title: 第3章 长青诀第4章 改进武技
slug: 穿越修真界开局娶了美女大师姐
lines: 次日早晨，莫凡醒过来走出房间时，看到雪儿正在练剑。
从少阁主莫凡的记忆中得知，雪儿正在练的剑法叫惊鸿剑法。
惊鸿剑法，名副其实，一把剑在雪儿手里，真是翩若惊鸿，婉若游龙。
莫凡看得心痒痒的，云霄阁的镇阁武技，偏偏自己无法修习。
雪儿看到莫凡，停止练剑向着莫凡走来。
虽然昨晚两人相拥而眠，什么都没做，但雪儿还是脸庞微微泛红。
“小凡，你醒了。”雪儿轻声道。
“雪儿，今天剑法练得不错。”
“嗯。我们一起，去跟爹、娘请安吧。”雪儿道。
于是，两人携手向莫唯风夫妇所住院子走去。
向莫唯风、黎秋兰请安后，莫凡让雪儿回去练剑，自己则拖着虚弱不堪的身体，缓缓在云霄阁内随意走动。初来这个世界，得先了解一下基本情况。
云霄阁不算很大，但也跟前世的一个小镇差不多了，到处是亭台楼阁，雕栏画栋，好不美观雅致。
不知不觉，莫凡来到一座塔型建筑，这是云霄阁的重地，武技殿。
进入大殿门口，就看到一个登记柜台，一个胖胖的中年人坐在那里，拿着一本书摇头晃脑，嘴里的哈喇子差点就要滴下来。
看到莫凡，胖男人打招呼道：“少阁主，刚刚大婚怎么不多陪陪雪儿却到处乱跑？”
“雪儿在练剑，我过来随便看看。”莫凡挥挥手，向二楼走去。
“唉，少阁主经常来武技殿，可惜又不能修炼。就像太监看着美丽的宫女，唉，煎熬。”胖男人摇摇头，继续看书。
莫凡来到武技殿第二层，看到十几个架子上，摆放着许多的卷轴。这些都是云霄阁珍藏的各类功法和武技。
以云霄阁的实力，等级最高的武技也仅仅是玄级中品的武技。
在玄武大陆，武技从高至低分为四个等级，天、地、玄、黄。而四大等级之中，还划分为极品、上品、中品、下品四个小等级。
据说，玄武大陆等级最高的武技为天阶上品武技。那是玄武大陆实力最为强大、地位最为超然的宗门——天玄宗的镇宗武技。
而像云霄阁这样偏居于玄武大陆南域苍州的小宗门，能有玄级武技就已经很不错了。
莫凡在书架之中缓缓走着。迷踪步，奔雷掌，烈焰拳，种种武技让莫凡心痒难耐。
满山的宝物，但是自己却取不了，这感觉真憋屈。
少阁主这具身子，真的是废啊！
忽然，莫凡左手上的戒指传来一阵轻微的震动！
莫凡十分震惊。
这个戒指他买了有一年多了，一直都只是一个普通的戒指。当初买这个戒指，他也只是图一时好玩又便宜而已。
戒指的样子很古朴，不知道是什么材质做成的。不好看，甚至还有点丑，所以莫凡才花了不到两百块就买了下来。
这戒指买了之后，莫凡一直都戴着，甚至都差点忘记了它的存在。
而现在，这枚戒指突然发出震动，这是怎么回事？
莫凡继续在书架间游走，戒指的震动更厉害了。
莫非，戒指是探测器，发现什么宝物不成？
content_en:
The next morning, when Mo Fan woke up and walked out of the room, he saw Xue'er practicing her sword.
From the memory of Young Pavilion Master Mo Fan, we learned that the sword technique Xueer was practicing was called Jinghong Sword Technique.
Jinghong Sword Technique is worthy of its name. A sword in Xue'er's hand is as graceful as a Jinghong and graceful as a swimming dragon.
Mo Fan was itching to see that he couldn't practice Yunxiao Pavilion's martial arts skills.
When Xueer saw Mo Fan, she stopped practicing her sword and walked towards Mo Fan.
Although the two slept in each other's arms last night and did nothing, Xue'er's face was still slightly red.
"Xiaofan, you're awake." Xue'er said softly.
"Xue'er, you practiced your swordsmanship well today."
"Yes. Let's go and say hello to dad and mom together," Xue'er said.
So, the two of them walked hand in hand to the courtyard where Mo Weifeng and his wife lived.
After greeting Mo Weifeng and Li Qiulan, Mo Fan asked Xue'er to go back to practice swordplay, while he dragged his weak body and slowly walked around the Yunxiao Pavilion. When you first come to this world, you must first understand the basic situation.
Yunxiao Pavilion is not very big, but it is almost the same as a small town in the previous life. It is full of pavilions, carved railings and painted buildings, so beautiful and elegant.
Unknowingly, Mo Fan came to a tower-shaped building, which was the centerpiece of Yunxiao Pavilion, the Martial Arts Hall.
Entering the entrance of the main hall, you saw a registration counter. A fat middle-aged man was sitting there, holding a book and shaking his head, and the cracks in his mouth were almost dripping.
Seeing Mo Fan, the fat man said hello: "Young Pavilion Master, you just got married, why don't you spend more time with Xue'er instead of running around?"
"Xue'er is practicing her sword, I'll come over and take a look." Mo Fan waved his hand and walked towards the second floor.
"Alas, the Young Pavilion Master often comes to the Martial Arts Hall, but unfortunately he can't practice. It's like a eunuch looking at a beautiful palace maid, alas, suffering." The fat man shook his head and continued reading.
Mo Fan came to the second floor of the Martial Arts Hall and saw many scrolls placed on more than a dozen shelves. These are all kinds of exercises and martial arts collected by Yunxiao Pavilion.
With the strength of Yunxiao Pavilion, the highest level of martial arts is only mid-level Xuan level martial arts.
In Xuanwu Continent, martial arts are divided into four levels from high to low, namely Tian, ​​Di, Xuan and Huang. Among the four major grades, they are also divided into four smaller grades: top grade, top grade, medium grade, and low grade.
It is said that the highest-level martial arts in Xuanwu Continent are heaven-level high-grade martial arts. That was the sect-suppressing martial art of the Tianxuan Sect, the most powerful and transcendent sect in the Xuanwu Continent.
For a small sect like Yunxiao Pavilion, which is located in Cangzhou, the southern region of Xuanwu Continent, it is already very good to have Xuan-level martial arts.
Mo Fan walked slowly among the bookshelves. Misty Steps, Thunder Palm, Flame Fist, all kinds of martial arts skills made Mo Fan feel itchy.
There are treasures all over the mountain, but I can't get them. This feels really frustrating.
The body of the Young Pavilion Master is really useless!
Suddenly, there was a slight vibration from the ring on Mo Fan's left hand!
Mo Fan was very shocked.
He bought this ring for more than a year, and it has always been just an ordinary ring. When he bought this ring, he just wanted it to be fun and cheap.
The ring looks very simple, I don't know what material it is made of. It didn't look good, even a little ugly, so Mo Fan bought it for less than two hundred yuan.
After buying this ring, Mo Fan wore it all the time and almost forgot that it existed.
And now, this ring suddenly vibrates. What's going on?
Mo Fan continued to walk among the bookshelves, and the ring vibrated even more violently.
Could it be that the ring is a detector, and it can't find any treasure?
